# `MC_knlGetResourceID`

Resolve a packaged resource name to a resource ID and size.

## Prototype

```c
M_Int32 MC_knlGetResourceID(M_Char *resourceName, M_Int32 *size);
```

```{doxygenfunction} MC_knlGetResourceID
:project: libwipi
```

## Usage

### Parameters

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `resourceName` | Resource path stored in the application package. |
| `size` | Output location that receives the resource size. |

### Return value

A resource ID or the provider-defined failure value.

### Ownership

The returned ID refers to package-owned resource data.
